entries.claim: VALR is an FSCA-licensed Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) holding Category I and Category II licences, plus an additional Financial Services Provider (FSP) licence.
VALR was granted an Over-the-Counter Derivatives Provider (ODP) licence by the FSCA (reported 20 October 2025), enabling crypto-referenced OTC derivatives.
VALR provides REST, WebSocket and FIX APIs, with SDKs for Python, Node.js and Java.
VALR exposes sub-account endpoints (create: POST /v1/account/subaccount; transfer: POST /v1/account/subaccount/transfer) and supports multi-user access with dual authorisation.
VALR charges a negative maker fee (approximately -0.01% rebate) on ZAR pairs, with tiered taker fees of approximately 0.05%-0.10%.
VALR has raised approximately $55 million in equity from investors including Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures, GSR, F-Prime and Avon Ventures.
VALR offers spot, spot margin, perpetual futures, staking, lending, sub-accounts, OTC desk, Simple Buy/Sell, VALR Pay and API services.
VALR launched xStocks, a tokenised US-equities trading product, in South Africa.
Reported scale: approximately 1.7 million users and approximately 1,800 institutional customers (late 2025).
FICA Directive 9 Travel Rule (R5,000 threshold, effective 30 April 2025) applies to VALR as a CASP.
VALR's actual matching-engine throughput (orders/sec) and latency are unverified marketing claims; no independent benchmark is available.
